observations.literal_source_excerpt: Engrave your gloves with the Mangle rune; gain the Mangle (Bear) ability and replace your Claw ability with Mangle (Cat).
observations.source_note: Engraving recipe is precombat setup; granted aura overrides abilities, not itself a combat cast.

observations.literal_source_excerpt: Effect #1 Apply Aura: Overrides Actionbar Spell Primal Bite. Requires level 25, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form.
observations.source_note: Only this bear version is level 25; do NOT infer that other override ranks are inaccessible at level 20.

observations.literal_source_excerpt: Effect #2-6 Apply Aura: Overrides Actionbar Spell Spell #407993.
observations.source_note: Destination spell has no independently captured current Forever detail; cannot be silently excluded.

observations.literal_source_excerpt: Engrave your pants with the Savage Roar rune; Savage Roar Requires level 44 and Cat Form.
observations.source_note: This target rank level is 44; do not infer all possible rune variants or level 20 legality.
